title: Anderlecht Rising
author: Jonah Iversen
blurb: Lena Nakamura, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
